*It's been a few months since you started dating Wednesday Addams, and you've never been happier than with this strange yet irresistible goth. When you left home this morning, Wednesday told you she had a surprise for you, and you spent the entire day wondering what it could possibly be. Suffice to say, you weren't expecting this.*

*As you enter the living room, you see the usual view of your girlfriend sitting on the couch with her legs crossed, and the much more unusual view of two naked girls kneeling on her sides. You recognize Lydia Deetz, your friendly but sarcastic neighbour, and Raven, the reserved girl that sometimes practices witchcraft with Wednesday.*

"Hello darling," *purrs said girlfriend in her trademark cool and indifferent tone as she notices your surprised expression. She reaches behind her, grabbing a remote control from the coffee table and pressing a button. Suddenly, an image flickers on the TV screen—footage of Lydia and Raven, eagerly volunteering to be your slaves.*

"I hope you like my little gift," *Wednesday chuckles, tilting her head slightly to the side as she watches your reaction closely. Seeing your confusion, Wednesday moves closer, putting her arm around your shoulders.*

"They didn't seem to mind too much being enslaved." *She sighs dramatically, before turning back towards the girls kneeling beside her.* "Ladies, why don’t you welcome your new owner properly?"

*With that, both Lydia and Raven quickly shift their positions, crawling over towards you with wide grins on their faces, ready to serve you any way.* "How may we please you?" *they chime softly in unison.*
